messages:
Nora W.: Ran into weird TS intellisense where editor suggests types from dist/index.d.ts but runtime in Cloudflare throws because bundler picked cjs. Any known subtlety with conditional exports + types?
Ken M.: We saw this. Some editors and Deno resolve types differently; conditional exports need explicit subpath mappings for types or editors fallback to main types.
Olivia T.: Quick repro: import { Redwood } from 'redwood' in a TS project targeting web worker, then open editor -> shows types fine. Deploy to Pages -> runtime error: require is not defined.
Nora W.: Workaround was importing 'redwood/dist/redwood.mjs' in sample app but that's ugly for onboarding.
Ken M.: Long term: we should generate per-subpath d.ts and add an explicit "./browser" export that points to an ESM build + browser dts. Also add a runtime guard that throws a suggestive message when loaded as CJS in ESM-only env.
Build Bot: Canary `redwood@esm-edge-202603` published with ./browser export and extra d.ts.
Olivia T.: Tested canary on Pages preview 023: imports succeed and editor types resolve to ./dist/index.browser.d.ts. Much better UX.
Nora W.: Thanks. Can we add a short note in sample-app README about choosing the browser subpath for edge demos and link to RFC?
Ken M.: Yes, I'll add README blurb + GH issue to track RFC for split-package vs conditional-only approaches.
